t: Timba TX double-countersunk decking screws provide a robust solution for outdoor timber construction. These 4.5mm x 65mm carbon steel screws are ideal for professional landscapers and serious DIYers installing decking boards, ensuring a secure and lasting finish. Featuring a double self-countersunk head with underhead ribs, they create a flush surface without the need for counterboring. The green organic Ruspert coating offers improved corrosion resistance, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. An ultra-quick start is achieved with the razor-sharp slash tip, eliminating pre-drilling in wood. The 40-degree thread ensures high pull-out resistance and secure fixing.
b: 40° Thread for Secure Fixing & High Pull-Out Resistance
TX Recess Ensures Enhanced Driving Capability
Suitable For All Decking & Outdoor Timber Projects
